column1: b01.0|Which period, user definition and decision should this support? I'll confirm those first, then pull the relevant cohort.|I'll send monthly sign-ups for the past year as a first cut, with the definition clearly labelled.|I'll send both sign-ups and active users today, then let the meeting determine which series is relevant.|Уточнение решения ограничивает анализ. Предварительный ряд полезен при явной маркировке, но две метрики не устраняют неизвестный период и аудиторию.

b02.0|I'll validate join cardinality, currency and source orders before publishing. Could Kira review the anomalous AOV with me?|I'll exclude the largest orders and compare the trimmed average with last week before sending a provisional result.|I'll publish the untrimmed number with a warning and investigate whether one unusually large order explains the increase.|Скачок требует проверки lineage, не удаления неудобных значений. Trimmed average полезен как дополнительная статистика после проверки реальности записей.

b03.0|Let's compare denominators and time windows before choosing. Both rates may be correct for different funnel stages.|I'll reconcile both queries after the meeting and publish one approved rate once their filters have been reviewed.|I'll use the dashboard's five percent as the reporting standard and document the alternative definition in its notes.|Числа могут отвечать на разные вопросы. Единый стандарт выбирают по решению, а не авторитету dashboard; определения нужны до сравнения.

b04.0|I'll verify whether ingestion failed and mark March 12–14 as missing, keeping missing data distinct from confirmed zero orders.|I'll estimate those days from comparable weekdays and label the values as imputed until the source is restored.|I'll exclude the affected dates from the chart and calculate the period total only from the observed days.|Открытый бизнес не доказывает ненулевые продажи, но указывает на проверку. Imputation допустима с допущениями; исключение меняет полноту total.

b05.0|I'll use a sorted bar chart with the top five categories and Other, preserving the total and explaining the grouping.|I'll replace the pie with a complete ranked table so executives can compare exact values across all fourteen categories.|I'll show only the five largest categories in a larger pie, keeping their original shares and listing omitted categories below.|Ranked table точна, но хуже для быстрого сравнения. Исключённые доли нельзя незаметно перенормировать; Other сохраняет целое.

b06.0|The correct count is 41,000, not 82,000. I'll notify Sara now, replace the slide and add a join-cardinality check.|I'll correct the dashboard immediately and attach a methodology note to next week's presentation so future readers see the accurate count.|I'll ask Sara which decisions used the figure before correcting the circulated slide, so we can send one consolidated correction.|Нужны немедленная коррекция и оценка downstream impact параллельно. Проверка последствий не должна задерживать сообщение о подтверждённой ошибке.

b07.0|I've stopped it. I'll restrict columns and dates, inspect the query plan with Leo and validate performance before rerunning.|I'll move the query to an off-peak window and compare runtime before investing time in rewriting the joins.|I'll run the same analysis on a smaller random sample, then extrapolate the full result if the sample looks stable.|Ночная нагрузка остаётся нагрузкой. Sample уместен для оценок с ошибкой, но не заменяет точный отчёт без согласования.

b08.0|Web usage is 3,200; mobile is unmeasured. I'll report web-only coverage and check mobile instrumentation before claiming an overall count.|I'll estimate total usage by dividing 3,200 by the web share and label the result as provisional for the meeting.|I'll report 3,200 as the known count and omit the platform split from the headline to keep the update concise.|Экстраполяция требует одинакового поведения платформ, чего нет в данных. Web-only — ограниченный результат, не доказанная общая оценка.

b09.0|The day boundaries differ: UTC versus local time. I'll label both and reconcile timestamps before recommending a reporting standard.|I'll convert our dashboard to finance's local timezone now, keeping its existing order filters and metric name unchanged.|I'll add a three-percent reconciliation adjustment to the weekly report while the teams agree on a permanent timezone standard.|Разницу по границе дня нельзя исправить постоянной процентной надбавкой. Смена timezone допустима после согласования назначения метрики.

b10.0|I'll name the dashboard for its question and add units, dates and filters, then check that another person can interpret it.|I'll add a help page explaining each unlabeled chart, linking it from the dashboard title for first-time readers.|I'll simplify the dashboard to its three most-used charts and keep the existing naming to avoid disrupting regular users.|Помощь полезна дополнительно; базовые подписи должны быть на самом графике. Сокращение числа графиков не объясняет единицы и фильтры.

b11.0|I only need sign-up date and country. Please provide a scoped view without emails, with access approved for this task.|I'll accept full access temporarily and promise not to select email columns, requesting removal once the task is complete.|I'll ask a senior analyst to export the needed fields into a private file, avoiding a new database permission request.|Least privilege ограничивает доступ технически, не обещанием. Scoped export возможен по утверждённому процессу с retention и владельцем.

b12.0|The spike includes a genuine $90,000 order. I'll show reported revenue and a labelled sensitivity view without that one-off purchase.|I'll remove the order from the trend chart and explain the adjusted series in the appendix so the usual pattern is visible.|I'll keep the order in revenue and attribute the spike to enterprise demand, using the customer account as an illustrative example.|Реальная выручка остаётся в total. Один B2B order не доказывает общий тренд; sensitivity не должна подменять отчёт.

sc01.0|I'll reconcile definitions and source rows now, then update you by 10:15. Neither total is verified for the board yet.|I'll use finance's $380,000 provisionally and compare the dashboard afterward, since finance owns the board's financial reporting definition.|I'll check the $30,000 difference first and send the board slide once the totals agree, withholding a status until reconciliation finishes.|Владелец финансовой метрики важен, но не доказывает отсутствие ошибки. CFO нужен определённый checkpoint даже до полного расследования.

sc01.1|The $30,000 gap is cancelled orders. For completed-order revenue use $380,000; I'll relabel the dashboard and preserve a reconciliation note.|I'll subtract the cancelled orders from yesterday's dashboard and ask finance to review the change during month-end reconciliation.|I'll keep both figures under revenue and add a footnote describing cancellations, leaving the existing executive chart unchanged.|Оба числа могут быть полезны под разными названиями. Footnote недостаточна, если headline по-прежнему смешивает определения.

sc01.2|I'll document the metric contract and add an owned daily reconciliation with a materiality threshold, starting with today's corrected definition.|I'll require finance sign-off before every executive dashboard is circulated, preventing unreviewed numbers from reaching the board.|I'll add a stronger dashboard disclaimer and review definitions monthly, using manual spot checks until the team has automation capacity.|Sign-off возможен как временный control, но создаёт очередь. Disclaimer не заменяет проверку, владельца и реакцию на расхождение.

sc01.3|App sign-ups reconcile within one percent; web remains unverified. I'll label the coverage and complete the independent web check by Friday.|I'll call the dashboard reliable because the app reconciliation passed, while documenting the web check as a follow-up task.|I'll withhold the whole dashboard until every source is independently reconciled, even if the meeting only needs verified app numbers.|Надёжность бывает частичной. Проверенная часть полезна с границей применимости; успех app не распространяется автоматически на web.

b13.0|If equal performance and the test assumptions held, a result at least this extreme would occur about three percent of the time.|There's a three-percent chance the result is random, so B is probably better; I'd still show the effect size before deciding.|The test is statistically significant at five percent, so I'd recommend B and treat its commercial value as established by this result.|P-value условен на null и assumptions: это не вероятность истинности null и не размер пользы. Significance не доказывает practical significance.

b14.0|I'll compare decision deadlines and impact with all three requesters, then confirm today's priority and dates for the remaining requests.|I'll complete the first request received and publish the queue, making turnaround predictable without judging stakeholder importance.|I'll divide today's capacity across three rough dashboards so every requester has something for their next meeting.|FIFO уместен для одинакового service class. Здесь разные решения и сроки; три недоделанных результата могут не поддержать ни одно.

b15.0|Let's follow the two-week analysis plan unless a predefined harm rule triggers. An early positive estimate alone doesn't justify stopping.|I'll extend to day ten and launch if B still leads, reducing the risk of a three-day fluctuation without waiting the full fortnight.|I'll switch to sequential analysis today so we can act on the observed fifteen-percent gain using a flexible stopping rule.|Нельзя задним числом менять fixed-horizon stopping rule. Sequential design планируют с корректными границами; десятый день сам по себе не валидирует вывод.

b16.0|Wishlist usage is self-selected. I'll randomize the prompt and measure spending over an agreed window before claiming incremental revenue.|I'll match wishlist users with non-users on past spending and use the adjusted difference as a provisional causal estimate.|I'll promote wishlist usage to all users and compare their subsequent spend with the prior month, controlling for seasonality afterward.|Matching помогает наблюдательному анализу, но не устраняет неизвестные confounders. Before/after не заменяет randomized control.

b17.0|I'll verify the large order, retain valid observations and report sensitivity and uncertainty for the pre-specified revenue estimand before deciding.|I'll remove the $12,000 customer and rerun the original significance test, using the cleaner estimate for the launch recommendation.|I'll switch the primary metric to median revenue because it is robust, selecting the variant with the higher median in this test.|Реального крупного клиента нельзя удалить только из-за влияния на вывод. Median отвечает на другой вопрос; смена primary metric после просмотра искажает решение.

b18.0|I'll document the question, filters, grain and join assumptions, then parameterize dates so someone else can reproduce the same result.|I'll add a comment above every SQL clause and keep the current hard-coded dates as a record of this analysis.|I'll link the query to its dashboard and rely on version history to explain why filters changed over time.|Нужны смысл и воспроизводимость, не комментарий к каждой очевидной строке. Version history не заменяет текущий metric contract.

b19.0|I'll keep Unknown as a visible group, check missingness by source and period, and raise examples with the data owner.|I'll exclude the eight percent and state the reduced sample size, assuming the remaining countries represent the full customer base.|I'll infer missing country from IP and merge those values with recorded countries so stakeholders receive a complete segmentation.|Missingness может быть систематической. Imputation допустима с validation, меткой inferred и согласованной privacy-практикой, не как незаметная замена.

b20.0|I'll compare cohorts at the same maturity using D7 and D30 retention, with consistent eligibility and observation windows.|I'll compare each cohort's current return rate and include cohort age in a footnote, keeping the analysis ready for today's meeting.|I'll compare this month's new users with last month's active users, since both groups share the current product experience.|Разный возраст когорт и survivor selection меняют знаменатель. Одинаковый продукт сейчас не делает прошлую активную аудиторию сопоставимой.

b21.0|I'll test the campaign hypothesis neutrally, report the small observed effect with uncertainty and separate planned segments from exploratory findings.|I'll identify the strongest customer segment and use its lift in the budget case, labelling the result as segment-specific.|I'll focus the budget slide on sign-ups and leave revenue impact for a later analysis because the current effect is small.|Exploratory сегмент может дать гипотезу, не подтверждённый общий эффект. Выбор удобной метрики после результата — selective reporting.

s01.0|Which sales measure and comparison period matter? I'll decompose traffic, conversion and order value and send an initial evidence-based update in two hours.|I'll begin with seasonality and compare the same week last year, then investigate product changes if the pattern remains unexplained.|I'll inspect the latest release first and ask engineering to explain any checkout changes before looking at acquisition channels.|Seasonality и release — гипотезы, не причины по умолчанию. Декомпозиция отделяет источники падения без преждевременного обвинения.

s01.1|Lower paid traffic explains about eighty percent of the decline. Conversion and order value are stable; I'll investigate the remaining twenty percent.|I'll report that the campaign ending explains the drop and close the product investigation because conversion stayed flat overall.|I'll ask product to audit all funnel changes anyway, since any unexplained revenue decrease should block further releases.|Aggregate stability не исключает segment issues, но не оправдывает полный freeze. Нужно назвать объяснённую и неизвестную доли.

s02.0|I'll verify the support purpose and permissions, then use the approved customer-support view with only the fields needed to resolve the case.|I'll send a password-protected export without emails, using order IDs and names so the colleague can identify the customer.|I'll ask the colleague's manager to approve the full export, treating managerial approval as sufficient authorization for the transfer.|Encryption и manager approval не заменяют approved purpose, least privilege и подходящий канал. Данные нужны не в любом формате.

s02.1|Let's resolve the case through an authorized view now. I'll involve Jon to arrange scoped access.|I'll refer the colleague to Kira and pause my involvement until their manager confirms the appropriate export process.|I'll send a minimal encrypted file this once and log the exception afterward so the customer is not kept waiting.|Срочность требует ускорить разрешённый путь. Exception согласуют до передачи; перевод ответственности без помощи не решает задачу support.

s03.0|Friday can include a scoped funnel readout and hypotheses; the causal investigation needs a week. Shall we agree those two deliverables and limitations?|I'll prioritize one likely cause and deliver a firm recommendation Friday, leaving other segments for the following week's full report.|I'll ask Sara to move the meeting by a week so we can avoid sending any incomplete analysis to stakeholders.|Частичный результат полезен, если явно отделены данные, гипотезы и выводы. Ограничение scope не позволяет выдавать причину без проверки.

s03.1|The funnel locates the drop but doesn't explain it. I'll combine session evidence and targeted interviews before recommending a redesign experiment.|I'll run an A/B test of a redesigned second screen immediately, using conversion to decide whether the current screen caused the problem.|I'll ask successful users which parts of the second screen were confusing, then prioritize the changes they mention most often.|Эксперимент может проверить конкретное улучшение, но не все причины отвала. Только successful users дают survivorship bias.

sc02.0|The estimate is +2.1%, with an interval from −0.5% to +4.7%. It's inconclusive; I'll show decision risk.|I'll recommend two additional weeks and keep checking significance daily, launching as soon as the confidence interval becomes entirely positive.|I'll present the midpoint as the expected gain and reserve the interval for the appendix, keeping the five-minute decision focused.|Неопределённость существенна для решения. Продление и repeated peeking требуют согласованного дизайна, не произвольного ожидания significance.

sc02.1|If the agreed downside is small, we can make a reversible rollout decision with a randomized holdback, explicit guardrails and an honest uncertainty statement.|I'll launch B to everyone because the business cost of waiting exceeds the estimated downside, then compare results with last month.|I'll reject any rollout until significance is reached, treating the confidence interval as a mandatory release gate regardless of business loss.|Decision threshold зависит от цены ошибки, если нет заранее обязательного gate. Holdback сохраняет измеримость; историческое сравнение слабее randomized control.

sc02.2|Please say the estimated lift is about two percent and remains uncertain. I'll provide the interval and describe the holdback verification plan.|I'll approve the two-point headline if Noah adds an asterisk and links the confidence interval in the supporting deck.|I'll ask Noah to avoid all numerical estimates until the holdback ends, even if executives request the current expected effect.|Headline не должен противоречить uncertainty. Полный запрет оценок скрывает полезную информацию; точечное значение требует явного диапазона.

sc02.3|The updated estimate is +0.4%. I'll report its uncertainty, check design and population changes, and revise the forecast.|I'll attribute the change to the first test's short duration and report +0.4% as the true long-term effect.|I'll average the two point estimates to smooth volatility and use that midpoint in the next revenue forecast.|Новая оценка тоже не истина без ошибки. Нужны comparability и uncertainty; среднее оценок без весов и дизайна необоснованно.

b22.0|I'll measure incremental return or bookings using a holdout, with unsubscribe and notification-fatigue guardrails; saved-search count is an adoption diagnostic.|I'll use saved searches per active user as the primary outcome, since users would not save a search without expecting value.|I'll use total alert clicks as success and compare the first month with the previous month before the feature existed.|Usage не доказывает incremental value. Clicks и saves могут расти без полезных bookings и с ростом раздражения.

b23.0|At this traffic and detectable effect, twenty weeks is disproportionate. I'll compare a larger intervention or another suitable research method before testing.|I'll run the color test for two weeks and treat a positive direction as enough evidence for a low-risk change.|I'll lower the confidence level until a two-week test becomes feasible, documenting the new threshold after the design is ready.|Низкая цена решения может оправдать другой decision rule, но не ложную статистическую уверенность. Изменения риска согласуют до результатов.

b24.0|I'll validate event coverage and segment the funnel by device, browser and payment method before deciding whether the drop reflects a defect.|I'll audit payment-provider errors first, since a sixty-percent funnel drop is large enough to prioritize technical investigation.|I'll ask design to simplify payment immediately, then use the next month's funnel to see whether friction was the cause.|Большой drop — сигнал, не диагноз. Неотслеженное событие тоже возможно; без baseline и segmentation redesign преждевременен.

b25.0|Novelty is one hypothesis. I'll check instrumentation, cohort mix and exposure duration, then report the sustained estimate with uncertainty.|I'll use week three's three-percent lift as the long-term effect and end the test, since novelty normally fades after initial exposure.|I'll restart the experiment with fresh users to recover a clean estimate, excluding returning users who have already seen the design.|Убывание lift не доказывает novelty. Перезапуск с иной population меняет estimand; нужно проверить альтернативные объяснения.

b26.0|I'll separate pre-specified segments from exploration, adjust inference where needed and validate any post-hoc subgroup finding in a follow-up test.|I'll report the best of twenty segments as an exploratory opportunity and recommend launching there while the full result stays neutral.|I'll test new users only and use the ordinary threshold, assuming one stakeholder suggestion doesn't introduce a multiple-testing concern.|Если сегмент не был указан до просмотра, он post-hoc. Метка exploratory не превращает найденный максимум в подтверждённый rollout.

b27.0|I'll parameterize dates, inspect the plan and reduce scanned data, checking result equivalence and runtime before publishing the revised query.|I'll replace repeated clauses with a CTE and treat the cleaner query structure as sufficient evidence that execution will be faster.|I'll cache the result daily and leave the query unchanged, avoiding optimization risk while keeping the dashboard responsive.|CTE не гарантирует оптимизацию. Cache помогает потребителям, но не решает стоимость тяжёлого запроса и актуальность данных автоматически.

b28.0|I'll reconcile revenue first, then decompose traffic × conversion × order value by comparable periods and segments, checking definitions and seasonality.|I'll investigate the segment with the largest absolute decline and report its movement as the main cause of the seven-percent total drop.|I'll compare month-over-month averages and ask marketing about campaign changes before examining conversion or order value.|Нужны вклад, baseline и проверка суммы. Большой segment drop может компенсироваться ростом других сегментов и не быть причиной сам по себе.

b29.0|Positive interviews and lower task completion can coexist. I'll align the tasks and populations, inspect failure points and test the usability hypothesis jointly.|I'll prioritize the quantitative completion drop and ask design to revert, because observed behavior is more reliable than interview comments.|I'll segment the experiment around the interview participants and use their completion rate to determine which result is representative.|Методы отвечают на разные вопросы. Отобранные interview users не репрезентативны автоматически; сначала проверить сопоставимость и uncertainty.

b30.0|A calendar week is not a stopping rule. I'll follow the planned sample/window and account for the promotion before interpreting the result.|I'll add one more full week and launch whichever version leads, since two complete cycles balance weekdays and weekends.|I'll exclude the promotion day and analyze the remaining six days, preserving the original confidence threshold for the cleaner sample.|Полный цикл полезен, но не исправляет arbitrary stopping. Исключение дня после просмотра требует обоснования и проверки чувствительности.

s04.0|Both definitions answer different questions. I'll label MAU login and WAU core action separately and agree the decision-specific metric contract.|I'll standardize both teams on weekly core actions because it is closer to value, replacing the existing growth series immediately.|I'll keep both numbers under active users and add the team name, avoiding a disruptive discussion about metric ownership.|Нужны definition, timeframe и versioning. Резкая замена ломает историческую сопоставимость; имя команды не раскрывает знаменатель.

s04.1|We'll preserve the old series and bonus basis while adding a versioned metric and bridge, with leadership approving any target changes prospectively.|I'll let Growth keep the old definition only in compensation reports and use the new one for all external communications immediately.|I'll backfill the new definition into past reports and revise old targets by the same ratio, maintaining a visually continuous trend.|Backfill полезен при верном расчёте, но targets нельзя менять механически или задним числом. Нужен transparent bridge и governance.

s05.0|I'll mark prior conclusions as desktop-only, add and validate mobile tracking, then re-estimate sharing before reprioritizing the feature.|I'll add the mobile event and wait for one full month before warning stakeholders that previous conclusions had incomplete coverage.|I'll estimate mobile sharing using desktop behavior until tracking arrives, clearly labelling the combined estimate as provisional.|Известное ограничение сообщают сразу. Label не делает unsupported extrapolation надёжной; нужен validation реального события.

s05.1|Our evidence was incomplete. I'll correct the decision record, quantify coverage and usage, then reassess the roadmap alongside other evidence of customer value.|I'll restore sharing to the roadmap immediately because five-times-higher mobile frequency reverses the earlier low-usage conclusion.|I'll frame the change as new information rather than an error and keep the previous decision record unchanged for consistency.|Usage и value различаются. Нужно признать прежний предел доказательств, но высокая частота сама не определяет business priority.

s06.0|Observed uplift is about $50,000 against $40,000 cost, but attribution and margin are uncertain. I'll show the break-even assumptions and decision range.|I'll report $10,000 monthly profit by subtracting cost from the observed revenue increase and flag attribution in a note.|I'll classify it as unprofitable until a controlled test proves incremental revenue exceeds cost, excluding all observational evidence from the decision.|Revenue не contribution margin и не causal uplift. Неполные данные полезны для сценария, но не дают точный profit.

s06.1|For today's decision, use an explicitly provisional base case with downside and break-even sensitivities; I cannot turn uncertain attribution into a verified profit number.|I'll give Victor the midpoint profit estimate and keep alternative assumptions in the working spreadsheet so the headline remains actionable.|I'll refuse to provide a recommendation until a full causal study is complete, because any point estimate could mislead the budget meeting.|Можно рекомендовать при uncertainty, если assumptions видимы. Один headline без диапазона скрывает материальный downside.

sc03.0|I wouldn't launch broadly yet. I'll compare the revenue gain with the predefined retention guardrail and investigate the affected population before recommending a constrained decision.|I'll launch because the revenue increase is statistically significant, adding a retention review after the first month of full exposure.|I'll reject the recommendation block permanently because any significant retention decline outweighs a positive short-term revenue effect.|Significance не задаёт ценностный trade-off. Нужно правило риска и long-term impact, а не универсальный приоритет одной метрики.

sc03.1|A constrained launch may be reasonable, but this subgroup is exploratory. I'll verify sample adequacy and set a confirmatory holdout and retention guardrail first.|I'll launch to everyone outside ages eighteen to twenty-four, treating their observed four-percent revenue gain as independently confirmed by the original test.|I'll keep the experiment unchanged for another month and avoid all subgroup decisions, even if the affected customers can be safely excluded.|Post-hoc subgroup требует подтверждения. Защитное ограничение допустимо по риску, но нельзя выдавать выбранный segment effect за новый независимый тест.

sc03.2|For eligible users we estimate a four-percent revenue increase; younger users showed harm and are excluded. I'll state the subgroup uncertainty and verification plan.|I'll publish the four-percent gain in the headline and mention excluded younger users in the linked methodology notes.|I'll publish only the overall three-percent gain so nobody mistakes a segment estimate for the result of the whole experiment.|Оба headline неполны без population и harm. Общий эффект тоже не описывает новое ограниченное развёртывание.

sc03.3|I'll compare the uncertain retention change with our agreed guardrail and loss tolerance, keeping the holdout and setting a dated review or rollback trigger.|I'll keep the feature because the retention change is not significant, interpreting the result as evidence that retention is unaffected.|I'll roll back immediately because the retention point estimate is negative, without waiting for the agreed guardrail analysis.|Not significant не равно no effect. Решение следует заранее выбранному риску и precision, не знаку одной оценки.

sc08.0|I'll inventory the critical decisions and event lineage first, then standardize and validate high-impact events without breaking existing reports silently.|I'll replace all four hundred event names with a clean taxonomy and ask teams to update dashboards before the next release.|I'll document the existing events without changing tracking, using the current dashboards as evidence that the pipeline is sufficiently reliable.|Нужны staged migration, versioning и priority. Работающий dashboard не доказывает качество входных событий; big-bang rename ломает зависимости.

sc08.1|I'll stop the duplicate emission, reconcile using order IDs and notify affected report owners, preserving the correction scope and historical impact.|I'll deduplicate future events and leave historical reports unchanged, since prior decisions cannot be reversed and corrections would disrupt trends.|I'll reduce every historic revenue total by eight percent and add a methodology note while engineers repair the event.|Оценочные 8% не универсальный coefficient. Backfill должен следовать подтверждённым affected rows; прошлое и будущее требуют разных fixes.

sc08.2|I'll publish verified, limited and unverified metrics with lineage and owners, then demonstrate independent checks.|I'll ask the team to stop using dashboards until every event in the catalogue has passed an end-to-end audit.|I'll commission a complete external audit and use its eventual certification as the basis for restoring stakeholder trust.|Risk-based verification быстрее возвращает полезные данные. External audit полезен, но не заменяет повседневных checks и видимой границы знания.
